headline: Barry Callebaut grows India inclusions; NY GRAS bill vetoed; clean-label mould inhibitor
summary: Barry Callebaut opened an expanded Baramati, India plant making baked and soft inclusions for bakery and desserts, a direct competitor move against Puratos fillings and Belcolade in Asia.
New York Gov. Hochul vetoed the first-in-nation GRAS disclosure bill, so suppliers avoid a new state disclosure duty for now, but advocacy groups will push again and GRAS dossiers should stay ready.
Cocoa prices are retreating and Asian chocolate demand is recovering, but supply damage looks lasting, so Belcolade should keep hedging and cocoa-reduction options open.
CSIR-CFTRI showed a Monascus pigment inhibits bread moulds as well as calcium propionate, a possible clean-label preservation lead for Bakery.
Zentis is showing heat-stable popping-boba inclusions for bakery, a trend format worth matching in Easyfil and Patisserie ranges.

items.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum Fermentation of Black Soybean Sourdough: Modifications in Sourdough Characteristics and Gluten-Free Bread Quality
items.summary: Chinese researchers fermented black soybean with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum into a sourdough that cut antinutrients and improved gluten-free bread structure, flavour and amino acid content.
items.why: Supports Sapore/gluten-free sourdough work: legume sourdough as a protein- and flavour-boosting GF ingredient.

items.title: Bread Staling Kinetics: Mechanisms, Analytical Approaches, and Mathematical Modelling—A Review
items.summary: Systematic review of bread staling mechanisms, measurement methods and kinetic models (Avrami, first-order) across 26 studies.
items.why: Useful reference for Bakery anti-staling enzyme and freshness-claim testing methodology.

items.title: Asia leads signs of chocolate demand recovery as cocoa prices fall
items.summary: Chocolate demand is showing early recovery in Asia as cocoa prices fall.
items.why: Falling cocoa prices and Asian demand recovery inform Belcolade pricing and Asia sales planning.

items.title: Application of Monascus purpureus CFR410-11 pigment in bread preservation and HRMS-based identification of thermally transformed pigment derivatives.
items.summary: CSIR-CFTRI showed a Monascus purpureus pigment inhibits bread moulds about as well as calcium propionate and identified its heat-transformed derivatives.
items.why: Possible clean-label alternative to propionate for Bakery mould inhibition; check regulatory status of Monascus pigments in the US/EU.

items.title: Barry Callebaut expands chocolate specialities manufacturing in India
items.summary: Barry Callebaut expanded chocolate specialities manufacturing in India.
items.why: Competitor capacity build in India's chocolate specialities market; relevant to Belcolade's Asia positioning.

items.title: Fi Europe 2026: How Zentis brings popping boba into bakery with heat-stable inclusions
items.summary: At Fi Europe, Zentis showed heat-stable popping-boba inclusions designed to survive baking.
items.why: Competitor in fillings/inclusions launching a bake-stable trend format; relevant to Easyfil and Patisserie inclusions.

items.title: Barry Callebaut opens its newly expanded chocolate specialties factory in Baramati, India
items.summary: Barry Callebaut opened its expanded chocolate specialties factory in Baramati, India.
items.why: Competitor investment in bakery/confectionery inclusions in India; watch for Belcolade and Puratos India.

items.title: Cocoa retreat reveals lasting production and demand damage
items.summary: Despite the cocoa price retreat, production and demand damage is proving lasting.
items.why: Cocoa supply and demand will not normalise quickly; Belcolade should keep hedging and cocoa-reduction options.

items.title: Barry Callebaut expands specialty ingredients production in India
items.summary: Barry Callebaut's new India facility adds production of baked and soft inclusions for bakery, confectionery and desserts.
items.why: Direct competitor move into bakery/dessert inclusions in India, overlapping Puratos fillings and Belcolade.

items.title: Spent Black Tea Powder as a Cocoa-Mass Substitute in Dark Chocolate: Phenolic Enrichment, Antioxidant-Related Activity, and Quality Attributes
items.summary: Spent black tea powder replaced up to 7% of cocoa mass in dark chocolate, raising fibre and phenolics with acceptable sensory quality.
items.why: Upcycled partial cocoa-mass substitute is a cost lever for Belcolade amid cocoa price volatility, worth tracking.

items.title: Spray-dried whole egg powder as an alternative to raw eggs in chocolate muffin production: physicochemical and sensory perspectives
items.summary: Study compares spray-dried whole egg powder with raw eggs in chocolate muffins on physicochemical and sensory quality.
items.why: Relevant to Patisserie cake-mix formulation where powdered egg replaces liquid egg.

items.title: Flowers works to get Dave’s Killer Bread back on track
items.summary: Flowers Foods is working to restore growth of its Dave's Killer Bread brand.
items.why: Signals pressure in US premium packaged bread, a key industrial Bakery customer segment.

items.title: Meliora’s plant-based egg hits shelves
items.summary: Meliora's plant-based egg has launched at retail.
items.why: Plant-based egg alternatives entering retail; potential egg-replacement benchmark or partner for Patisserie.

items.title: Consumer Reports statement on Gov. Hochul’s veto of New York’s GRAS disclosure bill
items.summary: New York Gov. Hochul vetoed the state's GRAS disclosure bill, which would have required disclosure of self-affirmed GRAS ingredients.
items.why: Ingredient suppliers selling into New York avoid a new GRAS disclosure duty for now, but state-level GRAS pressure continues; keep GRAS dossiers ready.

items.title: This Thanksgiving, Big Food gives thanks for Gov. Hochul
items.source: Center for Science in the Public Interest
items.summary: CSPI criticises Gov. Hochul's veto of New York's food additive (GRAS) disclosure bill.
items.why: Confirms the New York GRAS disclosure bill is dead for now; advocacy groups will push again, so monitor 2027 sessions.

items.title: FDA Allows Low-FODMAP Labels on Food Products
items.summary: FDA reportedly now allows low-FODMAP labelling on food products.
items.why: A new low-FODMAP claim route could support gut-friendly bread and sourdough positioning; verify the FDA conditions.

items.title: Hochul weighs first-in-nation food safety bill as both sides escalate lobbying
items.summary: Gov. Hochul weighed a first-in-nation food additive safety disclosure bill amid heavy lobbying.
